summary: All Veg supplies washed, peeled and cut vegetables, including chips, wedges and sliced potatoes, to restaurant and hotel kitchens in Cyprus. Its potatoes come from the Fresca family farm business in Kokkinochoria, and its factory is in Ormideia. The vegetable range began in 2017 as a venture of the Fresca family farm.
founded: 2017 (vegetable range; Fresca family farm business about 30 years earlier)
ownership: Venture of the Fresca family farm
products: Uncooked chips: 10 mm, 12 mm or 14 mm, skin on or skinless
Whole peeled potatoes: medium (35 mm), large (45 mm), extra large (70 mm)
Quarter, one-sixth and one-eighth potato cuts
Uncut vegetables and greens by the case
markets: Restaurant and hotel kitchens in Cyprus
facts: Team of eight produce experts, led by Andreas Petrides
Vegetable range sourced from local Cypriot farms since 2017
Vegetables come from farms no more than 40 kilometres from the prepping factory
Uncut cases: Small 7.5 kg / Large 15.0 kg
No stock kept; each order is prepared when it is received
limitations: The legal company name, owners and certifications are not published on the pages read.
Processing capacity, facility size, potato varieties, pack weights and prices are not published.
The site does not say whether the cut products are exported.
